approvers: My adviser or broker, my tax adviser, my house bank, my family
reason: A free first talk costs me nothing and the bank letter and named directors are better than most, so I will listen. But this is my life's work, I have never heard of you, and you have no earlier sellers I can ask. I would not sign with you in the next year.
objection: You have no references. I am handing over my customers and my three people, and I only have your word that you will treat them well. I also expect a higher price, because others will pay more in cash at closing, and 10% held back for a year does not sit well with me.
instead: Keep running the business and let my adviser run a process on nexxt-change, where I can compare several offers and ask for proof of funds from each. If nobody serves me well I keep working a few more years.
would_change_my_mind: A reference from an owner who sold to you or a similar buyer, plus 100% cash at closing at a price clearly above the other offers.
